title: A fix check may end on a merge of two lane commits that the verifier read
why: Owner chat 00:14 CST Nov 19 asked whether the merge tool's refusal of the PR 3694 record ("the head is a merge of a lane commit") is valid or a fixed bug. Triage read by REST: head 02736c944a of PR 3694 is a two-parent merge of two lane commits (d13b244d53, a32b081ff7), not main, so the carve-out for a clean merge of main (steps carry-forgives-main-merge, grant-line-clean-merge-no-verifier) does not cover it. Owner typed "approved" at 00:16 CST on the consultant's offer to fix it (relayed by the consultant).
source: consultant's offer; owner's word "approved" 00:16 CST Nov 19, relayed by the consultant; triage 12
note: Todo. Builder lane after the merge queue clears (the consultant's plan, his words). Refusal read by the consultant, relayed 00:18 CST (not re-run by triage): `merge 3694 --review-record --head 02736c944a... --fix-check 4432ddf11f...:reviewer:sonnet:PASS` at 23:59 CST, merge tool 908e15ad8601: "A head that is a merge must also be a merge of the base, and the log must read done, with no edit beyond git's merge ... A clean merge of main needs no fix verifier." Rule: the merge-head clause, decision pr-review-record lines 82-90. So the refusal is valid as written; the step widens the clause to a merge of two lane commits the verifier read. Check first whether steps fix-check-merge-forced-test and gap-check-merge-rebase (both ready) cover part of this.
